games.name: PlayStation Network
games.securityNotes: PSN supports 2FA and passkeys. The 2011 breach is historical; current account protection is strong with 2FA enabled.

games.name: Nintendo Switch Online
games.securityNotes: Nintendo accounts support 2FA and passkeys, but have a documented credential-stuffing history (2020 NNID breach). Enable 2FA and unique credentials.

games.name: Apex Legends
games.securityNotes: EA account supports 2FA; account-recovery can be slow, so protect the email account behind it.

games.name: GTA Online
games.securityNotes: Rockstar Social Club supports 2FA but account takeovers and modding-based theft are common, especially on PC. Use 2FA and a unique password.

games.name: Call of Duty
games.securityNotes: Activision accounts support 2FA but have seen documented account-takeover waves and account-unlink attacks. Review linked accounts regularly.

games.name: Genshin Impact
games.securityNotes: HoYoverse account supports 2FA and email verification, but spending-linked accounts are heavily phished.

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
games.securityNotes: Runs on Steam, inheriting Steam Guard TOTP 2FA. High-value inventory makes accounts prime targets.

games.name: League of Legends
games.securityNotes: Riot account supports TOTP 2FA and active account-recovery.

games.name: Valorant
games.securityNotes: Riot account supports TOTP 2FA; Vanguard anti-cheat and active account-recovery. High-value accounts are frequent targets, so 2FA is essential.

games.name: Roblox
games.securityNotes: Supports TOTP 2FA and account PINs. Very young audience is heavily targeted by fake "free Robux" scams and cookie-theft phishing.

games.name: Minecraft
games.securityNotes: Migrated to Microsoft accounts with 2FA. Younger player base is a heavy phishing target; account-migration confusion is a common entry point for attackers.

games.name: Fortnite
games.securityNotes: Epic account supports TOTP 2FA and email/app verification. Strong anti-cheat and active account-recovery support.

games.name: Discord
games.securityNotes: Supports TOTP 2FA, passkeys, and hardware security keys, but account-token-stealing malware and phishing are rampant on the platform. Enable 2FA and never run unverified scripts.

games.name: Steam
games.securityNotes: Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator (TOTP) and Steam Guard email codes. No passkey or hardware-key support yet — the mobile authenticator is the strongest option.

_note: Game security grades. Document-based, not a certification. CC BY 4.0.
